SectionVisualisations.VisualisationIdea: 🔄 Interactive Syntaxial Bends Diagram using CSS SVG paths with animated drawing effects (stroke-dashoffset) to show the horizontal span.
🏔️ CSS Stacked Elevation Layers using overlapping divs with varying z-indexes and heights to represent Himadri, Himachal, and Shivalik.
CSS Layered Soil Profile Box using linear gradients to show the rich alluvial soil layers formed by the river systems.
Interactive HTML/CSS Map with three distinct hoverable zones (Punjab, Ganga, Brahmaputra plains) that expand on hover.
CSS Grid Layout displaying distinct plateau tiles (Malwa, Marwar, Bundelkhand, etc.) that elevate (box-shadow/transform) on hover.
CSS Triangle shape created using `clip-path: polygon()` with a dark textured background to represent the black soil Deccan Trap.
CSS/SVG V-Shape Diagram showing the Western and Eastern Ghats converging at a central node labeled Nilgiri, with a pulsing CSS marker for Anaimudi.
CSS Animated Heat Waves and Sand Dunes created using overlapping radial gradients and keyframe animations for an arid effect.
Narrow CSS Flex Column adjacent to a blue gradient, with sticky scrolling to explore Konkan, Kannad, and Malabar.
Broader CSS Flex Column featuring expanding horizontal border-radiuses to visually represent the large river deltas.
CSS Floating Bubbles scattered on a blue background container, clustered into a large group (Andaman) and a small coral ring group (Lakshadweep).
SVG Branching Path Diagram flowing top-to-left, with tributaries lighting up consecutively using CSS animations.
Animated SVG River Flow (stroke-dasharray) starting from a single point and widening as major tributaries (Yamuna, Kosi) join in.
CSS U-Turn Animation path reflecting the river's entry into Arunachal Pradesh and its massive spreading network in Assam.
CSS Horizontal Scroll/Flow right-to-left, ending abruptly in a straight edge to represent estuaries instead of deltas.
CSS Horizontal Flow left-to-right that fans out into multiple small branches using CSS Grid/Flex to represent fertile deltas.
HTML/CSS Radar Map with 4 pulsing animated ring markers (using `@keyframes`) representing the 4 biodiversity hotspots.
CSS Masonry Gallery Layout showcasing image placeholder cards for Kaziranga, Manas, and Sundarbans that flip to reveal facts.
CSS Concentric Circles representing the Core, Buffer, and Transition zones of a Biosphere Reserve, with tooltips for Nilgiri and Kachchh.
